name: purple
shortdesc: purple-mri ex vivo MRI segmentation using nnU-Net and FreeSurfer
longdesc: Runs purple-mri nnU-Net tissue segmentation followed by surface reconstruction and atlas-based parcellation for ultra-high-resolution postmortem human brain MRI. Assign the input MRI to either InputMRI_RH or InputMRI_LH depending on hemisphere.
author: Pulkit Khandelwal
